verdict.rationale: Docs give clear one-liner style commands (`/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills` then `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills`) that make a skill collection available in the current Claude Code session, and invocation via `/skill-name` is documented. However, the flow is actually two chained commands rather than a single one-liner, and multiple independent hands-on reports describe skills failing to auto-activate after install, requiring explicit invocation or copying instructions into AGENTS.md to get reliable behavior. missing for 10: a true single-command install-and-activate flow, and independent confirmation that installed skills are automatically 'active' without manual triggering. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 full q7 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline partial q6. The story's load-bearing qualifier is installation with ONE documented command; the documented flow is two steps (marketplace add, then plugin install) and the Opus rationale itself names the two-step flow as the gap — a central-qualifier miss caps this at the baseline partial, not full. Anthropic-affiliation governance, README §9.]
